Initial release of 天枢黄道庫 (tianshu-huangdao):

- Supports Chinese Almanac lookups: query auspicious dates, activities to do/avoid, 12 Day Officers, 28 Lunar Mansions, 64 I-Ching hexagrams.
- Includes fortune-telling: input birth date and zodiac to get five-element attributes, lucky numbers/colors, and daily fortunes (career, wealth, love).
- Offers Chinese name recommendations: enter surname and gender for 3 suggested given names with stroke count, five-element fit, and meanings.
- Works offline; all data is local (no network required).
- Multilingual trigger keywords: supports queries in both Chinese and English.
